BiblicalUsage: The name is Ritspah, an Israelitess. You find the name in 2 Samuel 3:7, "…concubine, whose name Rizpah, the daughter of Aiah…", and again in 2 Samuel 21:8 and 2 Samuel 21:10.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Ritspah matters because God names his people one by one, and none of them is forgotten. I hold that no name in Scripture is there by accident.
